I40 S. 37 in force at 26.5.2016 by S.I. 2016/553, reg. 2

38 Power to board and search vessels or aircraft

(1) This section applies where—
(a) a police or customs officer has reasonable grounds to believe that there is
relevant evidence in or on any vessel or aircraft, and
(b) the vessel or aircraft is not a dwelling.

(2) The officer may at any time—
(a) board the vessel or aircraft, and
(b) search it for relevant evidence.

(3) For the purposes of exercising the power conferred by subsection (2), the officer may
require a vessel or aircraft—
(a) to stop, or
(b) to do anything else that will facilitate the boarding of that or any other vessel
or aircraft.
